raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Aspect ratio of the modeled half-beam",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 identifies a symmetric half-domain. Sec. 3.4 gives hexagon counts and relates rfill to the maximum length, but the coordinate formulas are absent. A 3:1 element-count ratio does not uniquely determine the physical aspect ratio. Here L and H denote half-domain width and height.",
      "readings": [
        "Use L/H = 3 by interpreting the counts as square Cartesian cells.",
        "Use L/H = 2*sqrt(3), preserving point-up regular-hexagon lattice pitches.",
        "Use L/H = 3*sqrt(3)/2, preserving flat-top regular-hexagon lattice pitches."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Outer contour of the half-domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 refers to Fig. 1(a) for the domain. Sec. 3.1 describes coordinate generation without providing the coordinates, so the boundary contour cannot be recovered.",
      "readings": [
        "A straight-sided rectangle obtained by clipping boundary hexagons.",
        "The union of complete boundary hexagons, retaining a stepped or zigzag contour.",
        "A rectangular Cartesian approximation to the hexagonal mesh's bounding box."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Symmetry boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 assigns the boundary conditions to Fig. 1(a); Sec. 3.2 names fixeddofs without giving its MBB definition. The text does not identify the symmetry edge in coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "The entire left edge, x = 0, is the symmetry boundary.",
        "The entire right edge, x = L, is the symmetry boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "External bearing location and footprint",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The MBB bearing coordinates and supported span are absent from Secs. 2 and 3.2 and delegated to Fig. 1(a). The alternatives below take the symmetry edge as x = 0.",
      "readings": [
        "One node at the opposite lower corner, (L, 0).",
        "One bottom-edge bearing at (0.95*L, 0).",
        "A bottom-edge support patch spanning 0.95*L <= x <= L."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "External bearing constrained degrees of freedom",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 does not provide the MBB fixeddofs array; the pertinent restraints appear only in unavailable Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical roller: u_y = 0, with u_x free.",
        "Pin: u_x = u_y = 0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "External load F",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 refers to Fig. 1(a) for F. Sec. 3.2 describes sparse force assembly but supplies no MBB row indices or coordinates. The alternatives use a left symmetry boundary.",
      "readings": [
        "At the upper symmetry-edge endpoint, (0, H).",
        "At the lower symmetry-edge endpoint, (0, 0).",
        "At the symmetry-edge midpoint, (0, H/2).",
        "On the upper edge at (L/2, H)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial application of F",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor the force-assembly description in Sec. 3.2 specifies whether F acts at one node or represents a distributed resultant.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the entire resultant to one node.",
        "Share the resultant equally between two adjacent boundary nodes.",
        "Apply uniform traction over a boundary segment of length 0.05*L, with the same total resultant."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of F",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names F without specifying its components or angle; its orientation is delegated to Fig. 1(a). Changing the axis can affect layout, although reversing the entire force alone leaves linear-elastic compliance unchanged.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward.",
        "Vertical upward.",
        "Oblique, with equal rightward and downward components."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude and half-model normalization of F",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No MBB force value is supplied. Sec. 2 also does not establish whether F denotes the force applied to the half-model or the total force on the reconstructed full beam.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply a unit resultant to the half-model.",
        "Apply 0.5 to the half-model, interpreting a unit F as the full-beam total.",
        "Apply a resultant of 1000 in consistent force units to the half-model."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 fixes Emin/E0 = 1e-9, but Sec. 3.2 only references the lines storing E0 and Emin; their numerical values are not included.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 and Emin = 1e-9 in normalized units.",
        "E0 = 210 GPa and Emin = 210 Pa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 specifies plane stress and Wachpress shape functions, but no Poisson's ratio is stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 0.",
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Constant Poisson's ratio 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The plane-stress description in Sec. 3.2 does not specify thickness or explicitly establish a unit-thickness convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length units.",
        "Thickness 0.1 in the same length units, with unchanged in-plane geometry and total force."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Mesh corresponding specifically to Fig. 2(a)",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.4 lists three meshes. The Fig. 2 caption assigns filters to rows but does not explicitly assign meshes to columns. The listed order suggests the coarsest mesh for panel (a), without stating that correspondence.",
      "readings": [
        "HNex x HNey = 60 x 20.",
        "HNex x HNey = 120 x 40.",
        "HNex x HNey = 300 x 100."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Numerical integration of element stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 names the plane-stress Wachpress formulation and references lines 45-56, but provides neither KE nor its integration rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Split each hexagon into six centroid-to-edge triangles and use three-point quadrature per triangle.",
        "Use the same subdivision with seven-point quadrature per triangle.",
        "Use adaptive integration until element-stiffness entries converge to relative tolerance 1e-10."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says move is defined on line 80 but does not give its value.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum density change per iteration: 0.1.",
        "Maximum density change per iteration: 0.2.",
        "Maximum density change per iteration: 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC update exponent or damping",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 3.3 refer to standard optimality criteria and an OcC update, but the actual update equation and damping parameter are absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Use x_trial = x*(-dc/(lambda*dv))^0.5 before applying bounds and move limits.",
        "Use x_trial = x*(-dc/(lambda*dv))^(1/3) before applying bounds and move limits."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "OC multiplier search settings",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 mentions the search interval inL and iterative volume enforcement but gives no bracket values, stopping tolerance, or bracket-expansion rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Bisect lambda in [0, 1e9] until relative bracket width is below 1e-3.",
        "Bisect lambda in [0, 1e9] until relative bracket width is below 1e-6.",
        "Expand the bracket adaptively and stop when relative volume error is below 1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Outer convergence criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says change monitors convergence but provides neither its definition nor its stopping threshold.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when the maximum absolute density change is below 0.01.",
        "Stop when the maximum absolute density change is below 0.001.",
        "Stop when the relative L2 norm of the density change is below 0.001."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Maximum optimization iterations",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 says maxiter is defined on line 80 but omits its value.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum 100 iterations.",
        "Maximum 200 iterations.",
        "Maximum 1000 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
